items.source:
Defaults to using the target class's declared cache operations if none are
associated with the target method. Any cache operations associated with
the target method completely override any class-level declarations.
If none found on the target class, the interface that the invoked method
has been called through (in case of a JDK proxy) will be checked.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果目标方法未关联任何缓存操作，则使用目标类声明的缓存操作。与目标方法关联的任何缓存操作都会完全覆盖类级别的声明。如果在目标类上未找到，则将检查调用该方法的接口（在 JDK 代理的情况下）。

items.source:
As this base class is not marked Serializable, the logger will be recreated
after serialization - provided that the concrete subclass is Serializable.
items.translation: 由于此基类未标记为 Serializable，只要具体子类是可序列化的，反序列化后将会重新创建 logger。

items.source:
Must not produce same key for overloaded methods.
Must produce same key for different instances of the same method.
items.translation:
不得为重载方法生成相同的键。
必须为同一方法的不同实例生成相同的键。
